
Batch 9 Question Bank

This question bank contains 30,000 newly created multiple-choice questions crafted to match the patterns and level of major Indian competitive exams such as SSC, RRB (Railways), UPSC, CDS, UGC-NET, Banking (SBI/IBPS) and others. Each question indicates the exam and subject area to which it is most relevant, presents four answer options, specifies the correct answer, and includes a clear explanation.

The distribution of questions aligns with the official exam patterns published for these exams: for instance, the SSC CGL Tier-1 examination has four sections with 25 questions each and a total of 100 questionshttps://www.careerpower.in/ssc-cgl-exam-pattern.html#:~:text=SSC%20CGL%20Tier,counted%20in%20the%20final%20selection. Banking and railway exams emphasize quantitative aptitude and reasoning, while UPSC and CDS exams test general studies and aptitude.

Q1. Exam/Subject: SSC/Railway Reasoning
Find the next term in the sequence: 1, 3, 5, 7, ?
A. 11
B. 9
C. 7
D. 13
Answer: B
Solution: The sequence increases by a constant difference of 2. Adding 2 to the last given term 7 gives the next term 9.

Q15001. Exam/Subject: RRB/Bank Quantitative Aptitude
What is the simple interest on Rs. 1000 at 5% per annum for 1 years?
A. 55.0
B. 50.0
C. 45.0
D. 60.0
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 1000, R = 5% and T = 1 years gives SI = 1000 × 5 × 1 / 100 = 50.0.

A. 124.85
B. 113.5
C. 102.15
D. 136.2
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 2270, R = 5% and T = 1 years gives SI = 2270 × 5 × 1 / 100 = 113.5.

A. 1289.77
B. 1172.52
C. 1055.27
D. 1407.02
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 9771, R = 6% and T = 2 years gives SI = 9771 × 6 × 2 / 100 = 1172.52.

A. 4271.65
B. 3883.32
C. 3494.99
D. 4659.98
Answer: B

A. 2956.27
B. 2687.52
C. 2418.77
D. 3225.02
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 12216, R = 11% and T = 2 years gives SI = 12216 × 11 × 2 / 100 = 2687.52.

A. 4425.7
B. 4023.36
C. 3621.02
D. 4828.03
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 12573, R = 8% and T = 4 years gives SI = 12573 × 8 × 4 / 100 = 4023.36.

A. 2931.85
B. 2665.32
C. 2398.79
D. 3198.38
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 12692, R = 7% and T = 3 years gives SI = 12692 × 7 × 3 / 100 = 2665.32.

A. 711.15
B. 646.5
C. 581.85
D. 775.8
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 12930, R = 5% and T = 1 years gives SI = 12930 × 5 × 1 / 100 = 646.5.

A. 7532.1
B. 6847.36
C. 6162.62
D. 8216.83
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 13168, R = 13% and T = 4 years gives SI = 13168 × 13 × 4 / 100 = 6847.36.

A. 5261.65
B. 4783.32
C. 4304.99
D. 5739.98
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 13287, R = 12% and T = 3 years gives SI = 13287 × 12 × 3 / 100 = 4783.32.

A. 8212.78
B. 7466.16
C. 6719.54
D. 8959.39
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 14358, R = 13% and T = 4 years gives SI = 14358 × 13 × 4 / 100 = 7466.16.

A. 5732.89
B. 5211.72
C. 4690.55
D. 6254.06
Answer: B

A. 1618.65
B. 1471.5
C. 1324.35
D. 1765.8
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 14715, R = 10% and T = 1 years gives SI = 14715 × 10 × 1 / 100 = 1471.5.

A. 7342.83
B. 6675.3
C. 6007.77
D. 8010.36
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 14834, R = 9% and T = 5 years gives SI = 14834 × 9 × 5 / 100 = 6675.3.

A. 3481.63
B. 3165.12
C. 2848.61
D. 3798.14
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 15072, R = 7% and T = 3 years gives SI = 15072 × 7 × 3 / 100 = 3165.12.

A. 2005.21
B. 1822.92
C. 1640.63
D. 2187.5
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 15191, R = 6% and T = 2 years gives SI = 15191 × 6 × 2 / 100 = 1822.92.

A. 842.05
B. 765.5
C. 688.95
D. 918.6
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 15310, R = 5% and T = 1 years gives SI = 15310 × 5 × 1 / 100 = 765.5.

A. 11880.33
B. 10800.3
C. 9720.27
D. 12960.36
Answer: B
Solution: Simple interest (SI) is calculated using the formula SI = (P × R × T) / 100. Substituting P = 15429, R = 14% and T = 5 years gives SI = 15429 × 14 × 5 / 100 = 10800.3.
